meta.title: Packets of noodles consumed monthly on a college campus

prompt: How many packets of noodles are consumed in a month on a residential college campus?

clarifications.answer: Assume about 7000 resident students and about 700 working professionals (400 faculty + 300 staff), each professional with one family member.
Count students and on-campus professionals with their families; ignore non-resident staff like guards and hostel workers.
Assume four weeks in a month.
Split each group into frequent, less-frequent and least-frequent eaters.

common_traps: Estimating only students and forgetting professionals and their families.
Mixing weekly and monthly rates without converting via weeks-per-month.
Applying one flat consumption rate instead of splitting each group by eating frequency.

anchors.1: Guesses a number with no per-group consumption build-up.
anchors.3: Estimates students only, or omits the weekly-to-monthly conversion.
anchors.5: Builds consumption bottom-up for students and professionals with an explicit weeks-per-month conversion.

anchors.1: One flat rate for everyone on campus.
anchors.3: Splits students and professionals but with a single rate within each.
anchors.5: Splits each group into frequent/less/least eaters with distinct rates.

anchors.1: Errors in the weekly-to-monthly scaling; lands far outside a plausible range.
anchors.3: Reaches a number with a slip, landing just outside 50000-80000.
anchors.5: Carries the per-group math cleanly, landing near 64000 packets.

anchors.3: Mentions a check but does not complete it.
anchors.5: Back-checks per-person: ~65000 packets over ~8400 people is roughly one packet per person every four days.
